revisions.description: Posts a message to a Teams channel or chat through a Teams Workflows webhook (the 'Post to a channel when a webhook request is received' template), as an Adaptive Card. The retired Office 365 connector webhooks are not supported.

params.label: Webhook URL
params.helpertext: The workflow's HTTP POST URL. It carries the webhook's signature, so it is kept like a password
params.name: webhookUrl

params.label: Title
params.helpertext: Shown large and bold above the message
params.name: title

params.label: Message
params.helpertext: The message text; Teams renders a subset of Markdown
params.name: message

params.label: Adaptive Card
params.helpertext: A whole Adaptive Card (type AdaptiveCard), or a whole webhook message (type message), sent instead of Title and Message
params.name: card
